title: Quadratic Sums-of-Powers for Fixed-Parameter Tractable Quantum-Circuit Simulation
summary: Strongly simulating a quantum circuit, that is, computing an output amplitude, can be done by summing the circuit's Feynman paths: a weighted count over assignments to Boolean path variables. The circuit's gates induce correlations among these variables, forming a graph whose structure controls several exact simulation routes. This sum-of-powers (SOP) viewpoint underlies recent simulators built on binary decision diagrams and weighted model counting.
